summary.added_external_crate_count_note: P2-G7 admits no external crate. Six process binaries depend only on the already-reviewed academic-policy boundary.

why_this_dependency_belongs_inside_its_t: Each path package is one executable with one exact ProcessClass binding and no product code beyond reading that class's broker-owned capability set. Separate packages make the indexer and export-job dependency closures independently auditable rather than relying only on runtime denial.
network_posture: All six boundaries depend only on academic-policy. The complete indexer and export-job closures and complete entrypoint sources are pinned; the egress binary has the logical outbound-socket capability but P2-G2 still owns adding the sole actual transport.
advisory_path: Unchanged. No external dependency is added; academic-policy's existing receipt remains authoritative for its dependency closure.
